text:
Sasha: Hey team, planning the safeswap for model-routing v3 during the 02:00-03:00 UTC quiet window. Intend to toggle feature flag llm_route_v3 via weighted warmup: 0% -> 10% (15m) -> 50% (20m) -> 100% (10m). Requesting on-call + release ops ack.
ben: ack for release ops, I'll watch SLOs and throughput.
tracy: svc owners notified. Are we doing sticky sessions or split by cohort?
Sasha: split by cohort + session affinity for legacy users. We also add a soft-fallback to v2 on latency > 500ms.
deploybot: Deploy scheduled: release/llm-route-v3 @ 02:05 UTC. Rolling deploy across 12 shards. Runbook: https://go/release/llm-route-v3
ben: Can we add a fast rollback gate at 50% if error-rate spike > 1%?
Sasha: yes. Plan: at each step we check epm/errors/latency. Manual stop at 10%/50% if alert fires. auto-drain at 80% threshold if deploybot sees sustained 3m error rate >1.5%.
infra-bot: Added temporary pin: version pin set to v2 for cohort 'enterprise' until 04:00 UTC. Command: `flagctl pin llm_route_v3 enterprise:v2`.
tracy: confirm the rollout matrix: cohorts A,B,C get weighted slices 10/40/50? also small EU region excluded initially.
Sasha: matrix: A=10%, B=40%, C=50%; EU excluded first 30m. Documented in release notes.
ben: I'll be monitoring token latency and queue sizes. If CPU on GPU nodes spikes, call rollback.
Sasha: quick checklist: 1) deploybot run 2) ff set 3) validate trace ids 4) manual 50% gate 5) confirm telemetry. Everyone react with :thumbsup: if ready.
tracy: :thumbsup:
ben: :thumbsup:
deploybot: Deployment started at 02:05 UTC on 12 hosts. Rolling 1/12.
Sasha: rolling now. ben, watch logs for rejections; tracy, watch EU traffic.
infra-bot: auto-snapshot created for routing-config before toggle: snap-7172468000.
ben: saw a transient spike at 12% -> holding at 10% while investigating. Raising a quick rollback? Error spike in auth proxy 0.9% -> 1.4% transient.
Sasha: hold. We'll pause ramp to 10m soak. If it stabilizes below 1% for 10m, continue. If not, rollback to 0% and drain.
tracy: checking traces — backend latency from v3 is higher for long-context requests; recommend limiting max_seq_len to 1024 temporarily.
Sasha: applying soft cap in routing config, pushing small hotfix. If doesn't help within 10m, we'll flip flag back.
deploybot: Hotfix applied, continuing soak. Next ramp to 50% scheduled at 02:40 UTC.
ben: metrics look stable after cap; proceeding to 50% at 02:40.
Sasha: thanks everyone. Postmortem/action items will be in the release doc. Closing thread when fully 100% or rollback done.
